Scripts.OnLoad:
local left = this:CreateTexture() left:SetTexture(0, 0, 0, 1) left:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", this, "TOPLEFT", 0, 0) left:SetPoint("BOTTOMRIGHT", GlueParent, "BOTTOMLEFT", 1, 0) left:Hide()
local right = this:CreateTexture() right:SetTexture(0, 0, 0, 1) right:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", GlueParent, "TOPRIGHT", -1, 0) right:SetPoint("BOTTOMRIGHT", this, "BOTTOMRIGHT", 0, 0) right:Hide()
this.leftBand = left this.rightBand = right
Scripts.OnUpdate: local show = GlueParent:IsVisible() and this:GetWidth() > GlueParent:GetWidth() + 1 if show == this.bandsVisible then return end this.bandsVisible = show if show then this.leftBand:Show() this.rightBand:Show() else this.leftBand:Hide() this.rightBand:Hide() end
